top_signals.title: YPF Investors Ask Supreme Court to Review Argentine Legal Win
top_signals.summary: Former investors in Argentine state oil company YPF SA have asked the US Supreme Court to review an “egregiously wrong” lower-court ruling that overturned a $16 billion judgment in their favor.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Micron beats on earnings and issues strong guidance as data center revenue jumps 11-fold
top_signals.summary: Micron is up over 500% in the past year as the company benefits from soaring AI demand.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Trump Accounts have auto-enrolled more than 60 million children, Treasury says
top_signals.summary: More than 60 million children have been automatically enrolled in Trump Accounts, according to a Treasury Department announcement exclusively provided to CNBC.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: CFTC secures over $30 million judgment against defendants in Fundsz fraud case
top_signals.summary: The CFTC secured a win in court after the agency said two defendants participated in a crypto scheme that they then tried to walk back.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Embattled Tata Patriarch Faces Revolt at Charities He Helms
top_signals.summary: A boardroom clash atop India’s Tata Group is spilling into the conglomerate’s controlling shareholder, as two key members of Tata Trusts challenge patriarch Noel Tata over a restructuring plan they say he pushed without consulting them.
